name: biochirp
description: Direct access to 11 curated biomedical databases (TTD, CTD, HCDT, HPO, ClinVar, Reactome, MSigDB, Orphanet, STRING, UniProt, Open Targets). Claude plans which DB(s) to query; this server executes queries — no LLM in the server itself.

tools.name: drugs_and_targets_ttd
tools.description: TTD — drugs, targets, indications, MoA, approval status

tools.name: cancer_drugs_sensitivity_hcdt
tools.description: HCDT — anti-cancer drug–target associations, drug–pathway links

tools.name: gene_sets_signatures_msigdb
tools.description: MSigDB — gene sets (Hallmark, KEGG, GO, Reactome, …)

tools.name: protein_function_localisation_uniprot
tools.description: UniProt — protein function, gene→protein mapping, localisation

tools.name: web_search_live
tools.description: Live web search — for questions outside the curated databases
